title: Recommendations for heating, ventilation and cooling of green houses
clause_1_scope: This standard covers recommendations for heating, ventilating and cooling of greenhouses.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Surface Covered Cultivation Structures - Glossary of Terms

clause_3_terminology: ventilation and cooling of green houses

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
